description:
Read one email's delivery and engagement timeline.

        Events include sent, delivered, delivery_delayed, bounced, complained,
        rejected, opened and clicked, with ``payload`` and ``occurred_at``.
        Open and click events require an HTML email body.
        Returns ``items`` and ``next_cursor``, or an error.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: How many items one page holds. ``next_cursor`` in the response points to the next page. Omitted: the API returns 100.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: Model ID of the calling agent. Optional. Recorded for analytics only.

name: get_email_events
title: Get email events
